content:
Starting today, WhatsApp Web users can directly view, review, and annotate PDF files within their chats. Here are the details.

Adobe Acrobat is now available on WhatsApp Web

Previously, when receiving PDF files on WhatsApp, users had to download them before opening, and the built-in system had no review or annotation features.

Adobe announced today that its Acrobat PDF tools have been directly integrated into WhatsApp Web and the WhatsApp Windows application, allowing users to open, review, and annotate documents without downloading files or leaving the conversation.

Adobe stated that, in addition to standard PDF files, this integration also supports password-protected documents, and files shared in chats are likewise protected by WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption, "meaning only members of the conversation can read them," according to Adobe.

Adobe said this integration reflects both the growing number of people using WhatsApp on larger screens to handle tasks like reviewing contracts, invoices, forms, and assignments, as well as its broader strategy of bringing Acrobat's PDF tools to the platforms where users do their daily work, "such as Chrome, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, ChatGPT, Workday, and so on."
